condition.question: Does the edited image depict the source image as a drawing made from chalk?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: the edited image should render the source image’s depicted content in the visual form of a chalk-made drawing, rather than merely adding an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
condition.binding: SOURCE is the image to transform; EDITED must show that same image rendered as a chalk drawing.
condition.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
condition.endpoint: The source image is rendered as a chalk-made drawing.
condition.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
condition.zero_when: The edited image shows no requested chalk-drawing transformation of the source image; unrelated edits do not count.
condition.half_when: The source image has a concrete but incomplete chalk-drawing treatment, with substantial visible aspects still not rendered as a chalk drawing.
condition.full_when: The edited image presents the source image as a drawing made from chalk, allowing natural variation in lighting, texture, and photographic detail.
